title: Free flight of a lone species-A particle with specular wall reflection

claims.statement: A lone species-A particle (no other particle in the chamber) moves in a straight line at constant velocity and reflects specularly at the walls x = 0, 10 and y = 0, 10. Tracker positions deviate from this model with sd about 0.05 per coordinate, no drift over the run. Tested only for start (2, 2), velocity (1.0, 0.5), duration 10, one x-wall reflection; not tested for other species, speeds, durations, or corners.
